Debt math leads deliberately counterintuitive employer-match exception, then IRA, Roth choice, delayed HSA reveal, 401k and taxable payoff. Repeated house/termites/sand-in-shoes metaphors and contrast transitions sustain explanation. Ending recaps sequence, no final subscribe/community pitch in stored text; description has community URL separately. First 30 seconds cannot be timed from plaintext. You know what drives me absolutely
crazy? Watching people throw money at
the stock market like they're feeding
coins into a slot machine, completely
ignoring the fact that they've got
credit card debt, charging them 22%
interest, sitting right there laughing
at them. It's like trying to fill a
bucket that has massive holes in the
bottom and wondering why you're not
making any progress. My name is Nick and
I spend way too much time thinking about
money, optimal inves
